deck_title: Pixar-Frisvad branchless rational orthonormal basis vs naive cross-up pole collapse rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Jeppe Revall Frisvad (JGT 2012) & Tom Duff et al. (Pixar JCGT 2017 "Building an Orthonormal Basis, Revisited") branchless rational quaternion-isomorphic orthonormal basis construction (s = copysign(1, nz), a = -1/(s + nz), b = nx*ny*a, T = (1 + s*nx^2*a, s*b, -s*nx), locking ||T|| = 1.0000x with zero sqrt instructions) versus naive fixed-axis cross product (T = (0,0,1) x N, ||T|| = sqrt(1 - nz^2) collapsing to 0.0000x at the pole nz = 1.0) and 64-substep Rodrigues geodesic parallel-transport rotation across 17 zenith cosine stations (nz in [0.0000, 1.0000]).
